review_notes: Export nested mappings, mixed sequence elements and string leaves as ordinary dictionaries. Scalar sequence elements are dropped, nested mappings are not projected and strings become lengths. Project nested Dict objects to plain dict while retaining all other values and sequence types. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'addict/addict.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('addict.addict')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from addict import Dict
value={'items':[{'n':2},3,'text'],'pair':({'k':4},),'label':'word'}
plain=Dict(value).to_dict()
print('plain_projection',plain)
assert plain==value and type(plain) is dict
assert type(plain['items'][0]) is dict and type(plain['pair'][0]) is dict
assert type(plain['pair']) is tuple
print('projection_value_and_container_fidelity',True)
PYREPLAY
